svg.title: The AI standard: four parts and where it was tried
svg.desc: The standard for the career AI has four parts: a levelled field at the class ceiling with all 23 AI cars at one PI on chosen models; a narrow speed band for every AI driver, one global edit that no track overrides; a gentler recovery off the track through a higher off-track speed limit; and race switches with slow-down and catch-up on and proximity and position spread off, with all four on left as a choice for the beta. It was tried on four circuits: Brands Hatch GP, where the AI left the track at one corner, is verified in game; Lime Rock South Chicane with no excursions, the Eaglerock oval that went well and class A 700, competitive with more incidents, are observed.
svg.text: Four parts, tried on four circuits. Evidence: docs/project/DISCOVERIES.md, D76 to D80.

g.text: A levelled field at the class ceiling
All 23 AI cars at one PI (S 800, A 700), on chosen models, in a free roster document.
A narrow speed band for every AI driver
One global edit of the AI statics file; no track of the game overrides it.
A gentler recovery off the track
A higher off-track speed limit: the AI comes back to the track faster.
Slow-down and catch-up on; proximity and position spread off. Beta: all four on.
Brands Hatch GP: the AI left the track at one corner
Lime Rock South Chicane: no excursions
Class A 700: competitive, with more incidents

svg.text: Status updated on 16 Nov 2026. Observed means seen in play, not isolated.
